metadata.description: The xgodev Claude Code marketplace: a single all-in-one plugin bundling every xgodev skill, hook, and tool.

plugins.name: claude-plugin
plugins.description: All-in-one xgodev plugin: the boost skill set (github.com/xgodev/boost), the Quality Gate (dispatcher + per-language gates + the quality-gate skill + opt-in pre-push hook), the dev-rules engineering-discipline skill with RED-first enforcement hooks, the skill-rules skill-authoring discipline, and the ux-ui design skill (searchable catalog + per-framework routing + UX methodology references).
